theorems.name: Submission.aal_dge1_support_density_lower_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (y : Amb n ℓ) (ω r : ℝ) (c : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ω → 0 < r → y ∈ μ.support → μ (closedBall y (2 * r)) < ⊤ → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ r → 0 ≤ c t) → Tendsto c (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ ball y r → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ r → ω ≤ (1 + c t) * ((μ (closedBall x t)).toReal / t ^ n) + c t) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε) * (ω * s ^ n)) ≤ μ (closedBall y s)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
